name: DrakesOmniConfig-Configs
description: Phase F1: modlet configs: bindings set another mod's BepInEx settings in memory, from their own value (baseline), never on disk. Target: the test-only plugin OmniConfigTestTarget (Tests/TestTarget), one setting of each kind plus one that looks ServerSync-synced. CF-00 writes two test modlets (priority 0 and 5) and reloads; CF-99 deletes them and checks every value went back.
